l1_words.meaning: the body of existing research on a topic

pattern_explanation: Turkish borrowed many academic terms from European languages, so several spellings look close to English. The same form can carry a different meaning in each language, so students should check the meaning and not rely on the spelling alone.
false_friend_warning: Careful: the Turkish word literatur looks like the English word literature, but in academic writing it means the existing body of research on a topic, not books or novels, so its English match is literature review.
